headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Python, Django, FastAPI, Kubernetes, AWS
summary: Backend engineer with ten years of experience building high‑throughput services for Berlin‑based scale‑ups and a major e‑commerce platform. Proven track record of reducing API latency by 40 %, cutting infrastructure cost by 25 %, and scaling event‑driven systems to 2 M req/s. Strong advocate of test‑driven development, observability, and platform‑level automation.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
highlights: Redesigned the core HR‑API using FastAPI and PostgreSQL, cutting 95th‑percentile latency from 320 ms to 180 ms (‑44 %).
Migrated 12 micro‑services to EKS with Terraform‑managed clusters, reducing monthly cloud spend by €45 k (‑27 %).
Introduced contract‑testing with Pact across 8 teams, decreasing integration‑failure rate in staging from 12 % to 3 %.
Led a 5‑person squad that delivered a real‑time notification pipeline on Kafka handling 1.2 M events/day with 99.99 % uptime.

experience.title: Lead Backend Engineer
highlights: Architected the order‑orchestration service (Django + Kafka) processing 2.5 M orders/day, achieving 99.95 % SLA.
Implemented automated canary deployments with Argo Rollouts, cutting rollback time from 15 min to 2 min.
Optimized PostgreSQL query plans and added read‑replicas, lowering average DB CPU from 78 % to 42 %.
Mentored 4 junior engineers and established a internal “Backend Guild” that produced 3 reusable libraries adopted company‑wide.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
highlights: Built the product‑catalog search API (FastAPI + Elasticsearch) serving 500 k req/s with sub‑50 ms latency.
Refactored legacy Django monolith into 7 bounded‑context services, reducing deployment frequency from weekly to daily.
Designed a CDC pipeline with Debezium → Kafka → Snowflake, enabling near‑real‑time analytics for 120 M SKUs.
Contributed to the internal Kubernetes platform (Zalando‑Kube), adding custom admission controllers that enforced resource quotas for 200+ teams.

experience.title: Junior Backend Engineer
highlights: Developed the transaction‑enrichment service (Python/Django) processing 3 M transactions/day, adding merchant categorisation with 92 % accuracy.
Automated CI/CD pipelines on GitLab, cutting build‑to‑deploy time from 45 min to 12 min.
Implemented circuit‑breaker patterns with Hystrix for external payment‑gateway calls, reducing cascade failures by 68 %.
Participated in on‑call rotation for a 12‑person team, maintaining 99.9 % availability for core banking APIs.
